jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List public job postings via GET /posting-api/job-board/{boardName}.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: List candidates via authenticated POST /candidate.list. Optional limit, cursor, syncToken, and createdAfter filters.

applications.list.title: List applications
applications.list.description: List applications via authenticated POST /application.list. Optional limit, cursor, syncToken, createdAfter, status, and jobId filters.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a single candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.info. Requires id or externalMappingId.

applications.get.title: Get application
applications.get.description: Fetch a single application via authenticated POST /application.info. Requires applicationId or submittedFormInstanceId.

applications.create.title: Create application
applications.create.description: Consider a candidate for a job via authenticated POST /application.create. Requires candidateId and jobId. No effect keys (creates always omit; a retry after a lost response would double-POST).

candidateId.description: Ashby candidate UUID to consider for a job.

creditedToUserId.description: Optional user UUID credited for the application.

interviewStageId.description: Optional interview stage UUID, or Ashby special string FirstPreInterviewScreen.

application.description: Normalized application after reconcile via applications.get.

candidates.search.title: Search candidates
candidates.search.description: Search candidates by email and/or name via authenticated POST /candidate.search. Requires email or name (AND-combined when both set). Not paginated; responses capped by Ashby (~100).

candidates.create.title: Create candidate
candidates.create.description: Create a candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.create. Requires name. AppCall websiteUrl maps to Ashby native body field website. No effect keys (creates always omit; a retry after a lost response would double-POST).

websiteUrl.description: Website URL. Mapped to Ashby native body field website.

sourceId.description: Source UUID credited on the candidate.

creditedToUserId.description: User UUID the candidate is credited to.

candidate.description: Normalized candidate after reconcile via candidates.get.

interviews.list.title: List interviews
interviews.list.description: List interview definitions via authenticated POST /interview.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

applications.move.title: Move application
applications.move.description: Move an application to another interview stage via authenticated POST /application.changeStage. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes the post-move application via applications.get.

archiveReasonId.description: Archive reason UUID; required when moving to an Archived stage.

sendAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 send time for the archive email.

application.description: Normalized application after EffectPolicy Reconcile via applications.get.

applications.reject.title: Reject application
applications.reject.description: Reject (archive) an application via authenticated POST /application.changeStage to an Archived stage with archiveReasonId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes the post-reject application via applications.get.

archiveReasonId.description: Archive reason UUID; required when moving to an Archived stage.

sendAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 send time for the archive email.

application.description: Normalized application after EffectPolicy Reconcile via applications.get.

applications.hire.title: Hire application
applications.hire.description: Hire a candidate by moving the application to a Hired interview stage via authenticated POST /application.changeStage. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes the post-hire application via applications.get.

archiveReasonId.description: Archive reason UUID; required when moving to an Archived stage.

sendAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 send time for the archive email.

application.description: Normalized application after EffectPolicy Reconcile via applications.get.

interviews.schedule.title: Schedule interview
interviews.schedule.description: Create an interview schedule via authenticated POST /interviewSchedule.create. Requires applicationId and interviewEvents (startTime, endTime, interviewers).

interviewSchedule.description: Normalized interview schedule returned by Ashby.

interviews.cancel.title: Cancel interview schedule
interviews.cancel.description: Cancel an interview schedule via authenticated POST /interviewSchedule.cancel. Maps interviewScheduleId to Ashby request body id.

interviewScheduleId.description: Interview schedule UUID (sent to Ashby as body.id).

allowReschedule.description: Whether the cancelled schedule may be rescheduled (default false).

interviewSchedule.description: Normalized interview schedule returned by Ashby.

jobs.get.title: Get job
jobs.get.description: Fetch a single job via authenticated POST /job.info. Requires id (jobId is accepted as an alias; id wins when both are given).

candidates.update.title: Update candidate
candidates.update.description: Update a candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.update. AppCall id maps to Ashby body candidateId; websiteUrl is sent as Ashby websiteUrl. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via candidates.get.

websiteUrl.description: Website URL. Sent as Ashby body field websiteUrl.

sourceId.description: Source UUID credited on the candidate.

creditedToUserId.description: User UUID the candidate is credited to.

candidate.description: Normalized candidate after EffectPolicy Reconcile via candidates.get.

offers.list.title: List offers
offers.list.description: List offers via authenticated POST /offer.list. Optional limit, cursor, syncToken, and applicationId filters.

offers.get.title: Get offer
offers.get.description: Fetch a single offer via authenticated POST /offer.info. Requires offerId.

departments.list.title: List departments
departments.list.description: List departments via authenticated POST /department.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List users via authenticated POST /user.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

sources.list.title: List sources
sources.list.description: List candidate sources via authenticated POST /source.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

archive_reasons.list.title: List archive reasons
archive_reasons.list.description: List archive reasons via authenticated POST /archiveReason.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

interview_schedules.list.title: List interview schedules
interview_schedules.list.description: List interview schedules via authenticated POST /interviewSchedule.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

interview_stages.list.title: List interview stages
interview_stages.list.description: List interview stages for one interview plan via POST /interviewStage.list. Requires interviewPlanId.

openings.list.title: List openings
openings.list.description: List job openings via authenticated POST /opening.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

candidates.create_note.title: Create candidate note
candidates.create_note.description: Create a note on a candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.createNote. Requires candidateId and note. No effect keys (no note get).

note.description: Note body as a plain string or Ashby {type, value} object.

candidates.list_notes.title: List candidate notes
candidates.list_notes.description: List notes on a candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.listNotes. Requires candidateId. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken.

candidates.add_tag.title: Add candidate tag
candidates.add_tag.description: Add a tag to a candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.addTag. Requires candidateId and tagId. Returns the updated candidate. No effect policy: candidates.get returns tag titles, not tag ids, so the write is not exactly observable.

candidate.description: Normalized Ashby Candidate (same shape as candidates.get).

outputSchema.description: The updated candidate returned by candidate.addTag.

candidate_tags.list.title: List candidate tags
candidate_tags.list.description: List candidate tags via authenticated POST /candidateTag.list. Optional includeArchived, limit, cursor, and syncToken.

candidate_tags.create.title: Create candidate tag
candidate_tags.create.description: Create a candidate tag via authenticated POST /candidateTag.create. Requires title. No effect keys (no tag get).

applications.change_source.title: Change application source
applications.change_source.description: Change an application's source via authenticated POST /application.changeSource. Requires applicationId and sourceId.get does not expose source. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via applications.get (sourceId).

applications.transfer.title: Transfer application
applications.transfer.description: Transfer an application to another job via authenticated POST /application.transfer. Requires applicationId, jobId, interviewPlanId, and interviewStageId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via applications.get (jobId/stageId).

startAutomaticActivities.description: Whether to start automatic activities on transfer.

applications.update.title: Update application
applications.update.description: Update an application via authenticated POST /application.update. Requires applicationId. Optional sourceId, creditedToUserId, createdAt, sendNotifications.get does not expose source or creditedToUser. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via applications.get (sourceId/creditedToUserId).

applications.list_history.title: List application history
applications.list_history.description: List application history via authenticated POST /application.listHistory. Requires applicationId. Optional limit and cursor.

application_feedback.list.title: List application feedback
application_feedback.list.description: List application feedback via authenticated POST /applicationFeedback.list. Optional applicationId, createdAfter, limit, cursor, and syncToken.

application_feedback.submit.title: Submit application feedback
application_feedback.submit.description: Submit application feedback via authenticated POST /applicationFeedback.submit. Requires applicationId, formDefinitionId, and feedbackForm. No effect keys (no feedback get).

feedbackForm.description: Map of form field path to submitted value.

hiring_team.add_member.title: Add hiring team member
hiring_team.add_member.description: Add a user to a hiring team via authenticated POST /hiringTeam.addMember. Requires teamMemberId, roleId, and exactly one of applicationId, jobId, or openingId. No effect keys.

roleId.description: Hiring team role id or name.

hiring_team.remove_member.title: Remove hiring team member
hiring_team.remove_member.description: Remove a user from a hiring team via authenticated POST /hiringTeam.removeMember. Requires teamMemberId, roleId, and exactly one of applicationId, jobId, or openingId. No effect keys.

roleId.description: Hiring team role id or name.

hiring_team_roles.list.title: List hiring team roles
hiring_team_roles.list.description: List hiring team roles via authenticated POST /hiringTeamRole.list. Requires namesOnly (boolean).

namesOnly.description: When true, results are role name strings.

users.get.title: Get user
users.get.description: Fetch a user via authenticated POST /user.info. Requires userId.

jobs.list_internal.title: List jobs (internal)
jobs.list_internal.description: List internal jobs via authenticated POST /job.list. Distinct from public jobs.list (posting board). Agent tool.

createdAfter.description: Unix ms; jobs created at or after.

jobs.search.title: Search jobs
jobs.search.description: Search jobs by title or custom requisition id via authenticated POST /job.search. At least one of title or requisitionId is required. Agent tool.

jobs.create.title: Create job
jobs.create.description: Create a job via authenticated POST /job.create. Requires title, teamId, and locationId. No effect keys (creates always omit; a retry after a lost response would double-POST).

jobs.update.title: Update job
jobs.update.description: Update a job via authenticated POST /job.update. Requires jobId and at least one other field. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via jobs.get with the same jobId (title, departmentId = teamId, locationId, defaultInterviewPlanId, employmentType, customRequisitionId).

job.description: Normalized Ashby Job (same shape as jobs.get).

employmentType.description: FullTime, PartTime, Intern, Contract or Temporary.

outputSchema.description: The updated job as observed via jobs.get (Reconcile).

jobs.set_status.title: Set job status
jobs.set_status.description: Set a job status via authenticated POST /job.setStatus. Requires jobId and status. Optional closeReasonId when Closed. Returns the updated job. No effect policy: jobs.get does not return the close reason, so the write is not exactly observable.

closeReasonId.description: Close reason UUID when setting Closed.

job.description: Normalized Ashby Job (same shape as jobs.get).

employmentType.description: FullTime, PartTime, Intern, Contract or Temporary.

outputSchema.description: The updated job returned by job.setStatus.

job_templates.list.title: List job templates
job_templates.list.description: List job templates via authenticated POST /jobTemplate.list. Agent tool.

job_interview_plans.get.title: Get job interview plan
job_interview_plans.get.description: Fetch a job interview plan via authenticated POST /jobInterviewPlan.info. Requires jobId. Agent tool.

job_postings.list.title: List job postings
job_postings.list.description: List job postings via authenticated POST /jobPosting.list. Agent tool.

job_postings.get.title: Get job posting
job_postings.get.description: Fetch a job posting via authenticated POST /jobPosting.info. Requires jobPostingId. Observe for job_postings.update. Agent tool.

job_postings.update.title: Update job posting
job_postings.update.description: Update a job posting via authenticated POST /jobPosting.update. Requires jobPostingId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via job_postings.get.

openings.get.title: Get opening
openings.get.description: Fetch an opening via authenticated POST /opening.info. Requires openingId (id accepted as alias). Returns the raw opening (isArchived, openingState, latestVersion.jobIds/locationIds). Observe for openings.update and G3 opening writes. Agent tool.

id.description: Alias for openingId (Idempotent observe injects top-level id).

openings.search.title: Search openings
openings.search.description: Search openings by identifier via authenticated POST /opening.search. Requires identifier. Agent tool.

openings.create.title: Create opening
openings.create.description: Create an opening via authenticated POST /opening.create. No required body fields. No effect keys (creates always omit; a retry after a lost response would double-POST).

isBackfill.description: Whether this opening is a backfill.

openings.update.title: Update opening
openings.update.description: Update an opening via authenticated POST /opening.update. Requires openingId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via openings.get.

isBackfill.description: Whether this opening is a backfill.

close_reasons.list.title: List close reasons
close_reasons.list.description: List job/opening close reasons via authenticated POST /closeReason.list. Agent tool.

openings.set_archived.title: Set opening archived
openings.set_archived.description: Archive or unarchive an opening via authenticated POST /opening.setArchived. Requires openingId and archive (boolean). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via openings.get.

archive.description: true to archive, false to unarchive.

openings.set_state.title: Set opening state
openings.set_state.description: Set an opening state via authenticated POST /opening.setOpeningState. Requires openingId and openingState (Draft|Approved|Open|Closed). Optional closeReasonId when Closed. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via openings.get.

closeReasonId.description: Close reason UUID when setting Closed.

openings.add_job.title: Add job to opening
openings.add_job.description: Attach an existing job to an opening via authenticated POST /opening.addJob. Requires openingId and jobId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via openings.get.

openings.remove_job.title: Remove job from opening
openings.remove_job.description: Detach a job from an opening via authenticated POST /opening.removeJob. Requires openingId and jobId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via openings.get.

openings.add_location.title: Add location to opening
openings.add_location.description: Attach an existing location to an opening via authenticated POST /opening.addLocation. Requires openingId and locationId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via openings.get.

openings.remove_location.title: Remove location from opening
openings.remove_location.description: Detach a location from an opening via authenticated POST /opening.removeLocation. Requires openingId and locationId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via openings.get.

locations.list.title: List locations
locations.list.description: List locations via authenticated POST /location.list. Regions are not returned. Optional includeArchived, includeLocationHierarchy, limit, cursor, syncToken. Agent tool.

locations.get.title: Get location
locations.get.description: Fetch a location via authenticated POST /location.info. Requires locationId. Agent tool.

departments.get.title: Get department
departments.get.description: Fetch a department via authenticated POST /department.info. Requires departmentId. Agent tool.

users.search.title: Search users
users.search.description: Search users by email via authenticated POST /user.search. Requires email. Returns [] when no user matches. Agent tool.

offers.create.title: Create offer
offers.create.description: Create an offer via authenticated POST /offer.create from an offer version started with offers.start. Requires offerProcessId, offerFormId and offerForm.fieldSubmissions[{path, value}]. No effect keys (creates always omit; a retry after a lost response would create a second record).

offerFormId.description: Offer form (version) UUID returned by offers.start.

fieldSubmissions.description: Field values keyed by form field path.

value.description: Field value (type depends on the field).

offers.start.title: Start offer
offers.start.description: Start a new offer version for an offer process via authenticated POST /offer.start. Requires offerProcessId. Returns the version id and formDefinition to fill with offers.create. No effect keys (creates always omit; a retry after a lost response would create a second record).

offer_processes.start.title: Start offer process
offer_processes.start.description: Start an offer process for an application via authenticated POST /offerProcess.start. Requires applicationId. No effect keys (creates always omit; a retry after a lost response would create a second record).

communication_templates.list.title: List communication templates
communication_templates.list.description: List enabled communication templates via authenticated POST /communicationTemplate.list. Optional ownershipFilter. Agent tool.

application_hiring_team_roles.list.title: List application hiring team roles
application_hiring_team_roles.list.description: List hiring team roles available on applications via authenticated POST /applicationHiringTeamRole.list. No inputs. Agent tool.

interviews.get.title: Get interview
interviews.get.description: Fetch an interview definition via authenticated POST /interview.info. Requires id. Agent tool.

interview_stages.get.title: Get interview stage
interview_stages.get.description: Fetch an interview stage via authenticated POST /interviewStage.info. Requires interviewStageId. Agent tool.

interview_events.list.title: List interview events
interview_events.list.description: List interview events for a schedule via authenticated POST /interviewEvent.list. Requires interviewScheduleId. Optional expand, createdAfter, limit, cursor, syncToken. Agent tool.

interview_plans.list.title: List interview plans
interview_plans.list.description: List published interview plans via authenticated POST /interviewPlan.list. Optional includeArchived, limit, cursor, syncToken. Feeds interviewPlanId for interview_stages.list / applications.transfer. Agent tool.

interview_stage_groups.list.title: List interview stage groups
interview_stage_groups.list.description: List interview stage groups via authenticated POST /interviewStageGroup.list. No inputs. Agent tool.

feedback_form_definitions.list.title: List feedback form definitions
feedback_form_definitions.list.description: List feedback form definitions via authenticated POST /feedbackFormDefinition.list. Optional includeArchived, limit, cursor, syncToken. Feeds formDefinitionId on application_feedback.submit. Agent tool.

feedback_form_definitions.get.title: Get feedback form definition
feedback_form_definitions.get.description: Fetch a feedback form definition via authenticated POST /feedbackFormDefinition.info. Requires feedbackFormDefinitionId. Agent tool.

custom_fields.list.title: List custom fields
custom_fields.list.description: List custom fields via authenticated POST /customField.list. Optional includeArchived, limit, cursor, syncToken. Agent tool.

custom_fields.get.title: Get custom field
custom_fields.get.description: Fetch a custom field via authenticated POST /customField.info. Provide customFieldId or referenceIdentifier. Agent tool.

custom_fields.set_value.title: Set custom field value
custom_fields.set_value.description: Set one custom field value via authenticated POST /customField.setValue. Requires objectId, objectType, fieldValue (null to clear), and fieldId or referenceIdentifier. No effect keys (no dedicated observe for the field value).

fieldValue.description: Value to set; null clears the field.

custom_fields.set_values.title: Set custom field values
custom_fields.set_values.description: Set multiple custom field values via authenticated POST /customField.setValues. Requires objectId, objectType, and values[]. No effect keys (no dedicated observe for the field values).

referrals.create.title: Create referral
referrals.create.description: Create a referral via authenticated POST /referral.create. Requires id (referral form id), creditedToUserId, and fieldSubmissions[{path,value}]. No effect keys (creates always omit; a retry after a lost response would create a second record).

creditedToUserId.description: User UUID credited for the referral.

referral_forms.get.title: Get referral form
referral_forms.get.description: Fetch the default referral form via authenticated POST /referralForm.info (may create the default form on first call). No inputs. Agent tool.

files.get.title: Get file info
files.get.description: Retrieve a signed URL for a file handle via authenticated POST /file.info. Requires fileHandle. Returns URL metadata only (no binary transport). Agent tool.

applications.list_criteria_evaluations.title: List application criteria evaluations
applications.list_criteria_evaluations.description: List AI criteria evaluations for an application via authenticated POST /application.listCriteriaEvaluations. Requires applicationId. Optional limit, cursor. Requires AI Application Review. Agent tool.

candidates.add_project.title: Add candidate to project
candidates.add_project.description: Add a candidate to a sourcing project via authenticated POST /candidate.addProject. Requires candidateId and projectId (candidatesWrite). Returns the Candidate object. No effect keys: candidate.info has no projects field and candidate.listProjects is a paginated list, so there is no exact observe.

candidates.list_projects.title: List candidate projects
candidates.list_projects.description: List the projects a candidate has been added to via authenticated POST /candidate.listProjects. Requires candidateId. Optional limit (max 100) and cursor. Agent tool.

projects.list.title: List projects
projects.list.description: List sourcing projects via authenticated POST /project.list. Optional createdAfter (epoch milliseconds), limit (max 100), cursor, syncToken. Agent tool.

createdAfter.description: Only projects created after this time (Unix epoch milliseconds).

projects.search.title: Search projects
projects.search.description: Search sourcing projects by title via authenticated POST /project.search. Requires title. Returns at most 100 results (use projects.list to paginate). Agent tool.

interviewer_pools.add_user.title: Add interviewer pool user
interviewer_pools.add_user.description: Add a user to an interviewer pool via authenticated POST /interviewerPool.addUser. Requires interviewerPoolId and userId; interviewerPoolTrainingPathStageId places the user in a training path stage.

interviewerPoolId.description: The id of the interviewer pool

userId.description: The id of the user to add to the interviewer pool

interviewerPoolTrainingPathStageId.description: Training path stage id; omit to add the user as a fully qualified member.

candidates.anonymize.title: Anonymize candidate
candidates.anonymize.description: Anonymize a candidate's personally identifiable information via authenticated POST /candidate.anonymize. Requires candidateId.

candidateId.description: The id of the candidate to anonymize

offers.approve.title: Approve offer
offers.approve.description: Approve an offer or a specific approval step via authenticated POST /offer.approve. Requires offerVersionId; approvalStepId and userId together approve one step, otherwise the whole approval process is approved.

offerVersionId.description: The id of the offer version that needs approval (entityId from approvals.list).

approvalStepId.description: Approval step id; when provided, userId must also be provided.

userId.description: The id of the user approving the step; required with approvalStepId and must be an approver for that step.

comment.description: Optional comment recorded with the approval; only supported with approvalStepId and userId.

excludeFormDefinition.description: When true, omit the form definition from the response.

departments.archive.title: Archive department
departments.archive.description: Archive a department via authenticated POST /department.archive. Requires departmentId.

interviewer_pools.archive.title: Archive interviewer pool
interviewer_pools.archive.description: Archive an interviewer pool via authenticated POST /interviewerPool.archive. Requires interviewerPoolId.

interviewerPoolId.description: The id of the interviewer pool to archive

locations.archive.title: Archive location
locations.archive.description: Archive a location or location hierarchy via authenticated POST /location.archive. Requires locationId.

custom_fields.create.title: Create custom field
custom_fields.create.description: Create a custom field via authenticated POST /customField.create. Requires fieldType, objectType and title; selectableValues is required for ValueSelect and MultiValueSelect field types.

fieldType.description: The type of field being created (case-sensitive).

objectType.description: The type of object the field can be associated with.

selectableValues.description: Selectable values for ValueSelect and MultiValueSelect fields.

label.description: The display label for this selectable value

value.description: The internal value for this selectable value (unique identifier)

isDateOnlyField.description: Only for Date fields; whether the field holds a date without time content.

isExposableToCandidate.description: Whether the field can be exposed to a candidate in certain contexts.

isPrivate.description: Whether the custom field should be private.

isEditableOnlyViaPublicApi.description: Whether the field value can only be edited through the API (Job and Opening fields).

departments.create.title: Create department
departments.create.description: Create a department or team via authenticated POST /department.create. Requires name.

name.description: The name of the department or team

externalName.description: Candidate-facing name used on Ashby job boards.

parentId.description: The id of the department's parent department.

extraData.description: Key-value pairs for your own use and reference.

interviewer_pools.create.title: Create interviewer pool
interviewer_pools.create.description: Create an interviewer pool via authenticated POST /interviewerPool.create. Requires title.

title.description: The title of the interviewer pool

requiresTraining.description: Whether the interviewer pool requires training.

locations.create.title: Create location
locations.create.description: Create a location or location hierarchy via authenticated POST /location.create. Requires name and type.

type.description: Location is assignable to jobs and employees; LocationHierarchy groups locations or other hierarchies.

postalAddress.description: The postal address for the location

addressCountry.description: The country for the location address

addressRegion.description: The region for the location address

addressLocality.description: The locality for the location address

postalCode.description: The postal code for the location address

streetAddress.description: The street address for the location

parentLocationId.description: The id of the location's parent.

isRemote.description: Whether the location is labeled remote (not allowed for hierarchies).

workplaceType.description: The type of workplace (not allowed for hierarchies).

externalName.description: Candidate-facing name used on job boards and in the API.

extraData.description: Structured key-value information for your own use and reference.

survey_requests.create.title: Create survey request
survey_requests.create.description: Create a survey request and return a survey URL via authenticated POST /surveyRequest.create. Requires candidateId, applicationId and surveyFormDefinitionId.

candidateId.description: The id of the candidate to create a survey request for.

applicationId.description: The id of the application to associate with the survey request.

surveyFormDefinitionId.description: The survey form definition the candidate will see.

survey_submissions.create.title: Create survey submission
survey_submissions.create.description: Submit survey answers via authenticated POST /surveySubmission.create. Requires surveyFormDefinitionId, candidateId, applicationId and submittedValues.

surveyFormDefinitionId.description: The unique identifier of the survey form definition to submit.

candidateId.description: The unique identifier of the candidate submitting the survey.

applicationId.description: The unique identifier of the associated application.

submittedValues.description: A map of form field paths to submitted values.

interviewer_pools.get.title: Get interviewer pool
interviewer_pools.get.description: Get information about an interviewer pool via authenticated POST /interviewerPool.info. Requires interviewerPoolId.

interviewerPoolId.description: The id of the interviewer pool

users.get_interviewer_settings.title: Get interviewer settings
users.get_interviewer_settings.description: Get a user's interviewer settings via authenticated POST /user.interviewerSettings. Requires userId.

userId.description: The id of the user to get interviewer settings for

survey_form_definitions.get.title: Get survey form definition
survey_form_definitions.get.description: Get a survey form definition via authenticated POST /surveyFormDefinition.info. Requires surveyFormDefinitionId.

surveyFormDefinitionId.description: The unique identifier of the survey form definition to fetch

approvals.list.title: List approvals
approvals.list.description: List approvals via authenticated POST /approval.list, optionally filtered by entityType and entityId. Cursor pagination via cursor (start or nextCursor) and limit; moreDataAvailable signals another page.

entityType.description: Filter approvals by the type of entity they are associated with.

entityId.description: Filter approvals to those associated with this specific entity id.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: 'start' for the first page or nextCursor from a previous response.

syncToken.description: Sync token from a previous list response to fetch only approvals updated since.

brands.list.title: List brands
brands.list.description: List all brands for the organization via authenticated POST /brand.list. Cursor pagination via cursor (start or nextCursor) and limit; moreDataAvailable signals another page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: 'start' for the first page or nextCursor from a previous response.

candidates.list_client_info.title: List candidate client info
candidates.list_client_info.description: List client information records (IP, user agent) for a candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.listClientInfo. Requires candidateId. Cursor pagination via cursor (start or nextCursor) and limit; moreDataAvailable signals another page.

candidateId.description: The id of the candidate to fetch client info for

cursor.description: Opaque cursor indicating which page of results to fetch.

syncToken.description: Sync token from a previous list response to fetch only records updated since.

limit.description: Maximum items per page (maximum and default 100).

interviewer_pools.list.title: List interviewer pools
interviewer_pools.list.description: List all interviewer pools via authenticated POST /interviewerPool.list. Cursor pagination via cursor (start or nextCursor) and limit; moreDataAvailable signals another page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: 'start' for the first page or nextCursor from a previous response.

syncToken.description: Sync token from a previous list response to fetch only pools updated since.

includeArchivedPools.description: When true, include archived pools (default false).

includeArchivedTrainingStages.description: When true, include archived training stages (default true).

job_boards.list.title: List job boards
job_boards.list.description: List all enabled job boards via authenticated POST /jobBoard.list. Responses carry nextCursor and moreDataAvailable.

source_tracking_links.list.title: List source tracking links
source_tracking_links.list.description: List source custom tracking links via authenticated POST /sourceTrackingLink.list, optionally filtered by sourceId. Cursor pagination via cursor (start or nextCursor) and limit; moreDataAvailable signals another page.

includeDisabled.description: When true, include disabled tracking links (default false).

sourceId.description: Restrict the response to tracking links associated with this source id.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: 'start' for the first page or nextCursor from a previous response.

syncToken.description: Sync token from a previous list response to fetch only links updated since.

survey_form_definitions.list.title: List survey form definitions
survey_form_definitions.list.description: List all survey form definitions via authenticated POST /surveyFormDefinition.list. Cursor pagination via cursor (start or nextCursor) and limit; moreDataAvailable signals another page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: 'start' for the first page or nextCursor from a previous response.

syncToken.description: Sync token from a previous list response to fetch only definitions updated since.

limit.description: Maximum survey form definitions per page.

survey_submissions.list.title: List survey submissions
survey_submissions.list.description: List survey submissions of one surveyType via authenticated POST /surveySubmission.list. Requires surveyType. Cursor pagination via cursor (start or nextCursor) and limit; moreDataAvailable signals another page.

surveyType.description: The type of survey submissions to fetch.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: 'start' for the first page or nextCursor from a previous response.

syncToken.description: Sync token from a previous list response to fetch only submissions updated since.

createdAfter.description: Return submissions created at or after this date (Unix timestamp in milliseconds).

departments.move.title: Move department
departments.move.description: Move a department to another parent via authenticated POST /department.move. Requires departmentId; omit parentId to move to the top level.

parentId.description: The department parent's ID; omit or null to move to the top level.

locations.move.title: Move location
locations.move.description: Move a location in the location hierarchy via authenticated POST /location.move. Requires locationId and parentLocationHierarchyId.

parentLocationHierarchyId.description: The id of the parent location hierarchy

interviewer_pools.remove_user.title: Remove interviewer pool user
interviewer_pools.remove_user.description: Remove a user from an interviewer pool via authenticated POST /interviewerPool.removeUser. Requires interviewerPoolId and userId.

interviewerPoolId.description: The id of the interviewer pool

userId.description: The id of the user to remove from the interviewer pool

departments.restore.title: Restore department
departments.restore.description: Restore a department via authenticated POST /department.restore. Requires departmentId.

interviewer_pools.restore.title: Restore interviewer pool
interviewer_pools.restore.description: Restore an archived interviewer pool via authenticated POST /interviewerPool.restore. Requires interviewerPoolId.

interviewerPoolId.description: The id of the interviewer pool to restore

locations.restore.title: Restore location
locations.restore.description: Restore an archived location or location hierarchy via authenticated POST /location.restore. Requires locationId.

locationId.description: The id of the location to restore

applications.update_history.title: Update application history
applications.update_history.description: Update stage timestamps and delete history events via authenticated POST /application.updateHistory. Requires applicationId and the full applicationHistory array.

applicationId.description: The id of the application whose history to update.

applicationHistory.description: The full array of application history events (not just the changed ones).

stageNumber.description: Stage number in the application history.

enteredStageAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the stage was entered.

applicationHistoryId.description: Existing history event id to update.

jobs.update_compensation.title: Update job compensation
jobs.update_compensation.description: Replace the compensation tiers on a job via authenticated POST /job.updateCompensation. Requires jobId and compensationTiers; pass an empty array to clear existing compensation.

jobId.description: The unique id of the job to update

compensationTiers.description: Compensation tiers to set on the job; an empty array clears existing compensation.

title.description: Label describing the entire range (required when more than one tier is provided).

compensationType.description: The type of compensation this component represents.

interval.description: The frequency at which this compensation is given.

label.description: Optional label describing this compensation range.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code (not used for EquityPercentage).

departments.update.title: Update department
departments.update.description: Update a department via authenticated POST /department.update. Requires departmentId and name.

name.description: The name of the department or team

externalName.description: Candidate-facing name used on Ashby job boards.

extraData.description: Key-value pairs for your own use and reference.

interviewer_pools.update.title: Update interviewer pool
interviewer_pools.update.description: Update an interviewer pool via authenticated POST /interviewerPool.update. Requires interviewerPoolId and at least one editable field.

interviewerPoolId.description: The id of the interviewer pool to update

title.description: The title of the interviewer pool.

requiresTraining.description: Whether the interviewer pool requires training.

locations.update_address.title: Update location address
locations.update_address.description: Update the address of a location via authenticated POST /location.updateAddress. Requires locationId; pass address null to clear.

address.description: The address of the location; null clears it.

postalAddress.description: The postal address for the location

addressCountry.description: The country for the location address

addressRegion.description: The region for the location address

addressLocality.description: The locality for the location address

postalCode.description: The postal code for the location address

streetAddress.description: The street address for the location

locations.update_external_name.title: Update location external name
locations.update_external_name.description: Update a location's external (candidate-facing) name via authenticated POST /location.updateExternalName. Requires locationId; pass externalName null to clear.

externalName.description: Candidate-facing name used on job boards and in the API; null clears it.

locations.update_name.title: Update location name
locations.update_name.description: Update a location's name via authenticated POST /location.updateName. Requires locationId and name.

locations.update_workplace_type.title: Update location workplace type
locations.update_workplace_type.description: Update a location's workplace type via authenticated POST /location.updateWorkplaceType. Requires locationId and workplaceType; hierarchies cannot carry a workplace type.

custom_fields.update_selectable_values.title: Update custom field selectable values
custom_fields.update_selectable_values.description: Merge selectable values into a custom field via authenticated POST /customField.updateSelectableValues. Requires selectableValues plus customFieldId or referenceIdentifier.

customFieldId.description: The id of the custom field to update.

referenceIdentifier.description: Beta: the reference ID assigned to the custom field, e.g. cost_center.

selectableValues.description: Selectable values to merge with the existing values.

label.description: The display label for this selectable value

value.description: The internal value for this selectable value (unique identifier)

isArchived.description: Whether this value should be archived (default false).

users.update_interviewer_settings.title: Update interviewer settings
users.update_interviewer_settings.description: Update a user's interviewer settings via authenticated POST /user.updateInterviewerSettings. Requires userId; dailyLimit and weeklyLimit are nullable.

userId.description: The id of the user to update interviewer settings for

dailyLimit.description: Maximum interviews per day for this interviewer.

weeklyLimit.description: Maximum interviews per week for this interviewer.
